session_key_note: Date timestamp is provisional because the source has no explicit session id.
source_row_numbering: CSV header is row 1; data rows begin at source_row 2.

exact_duplicate_policy.action: retain every raw row in lineage; keep the lowest source_row as the processed representative

alias_policy.merge_rule: apply only rows whose decision is merge
alias_policy.deferred_rule: do not merge deferred or rejected candidates
alias_policy.alias_shadow_action: retain in lineage and map to the representative processed_set_id

set_order_collision_policy.action: retain all distinct value rows and flag the collision

rules.metric_action: exclude from volume and e1RM until reviewed
retain for volume when otherwise valid; exclude from e1RM

rules.condition: Weight > 0 and Reps == 0 and Distance == 0 and Seconds == 0
rules.metric_action: exclude from volume and e1RM until reviewed

volume_load.eligibility: representative row, weight > 0, reps > 0, no metric-blocking outlier

estimated_1rm.eligibility: representative row, weight > 0, reps in [1, 12], no metric-blocking outlier
